L13@P0: High Dose Ifosfamide Therapy- 21 day
L14@P0: INDICATIONS FOR USE:
L15@P0: INDICATION ICD10
L16@P0: Regimen
L17@P0: Code
L18@P0: HSE approved
L19@P0: reimbursement
L20@P0: status*
L21@P0: Recurrent and Primary Refractory Ewing Sarcoma C49 00680a N/A
L22@P0: Relapsed osteosarcoma C41 00680b N/A
L23@P0: *This applies to post 2012 indications.
L24@P0: TREATMENT:
L25@P0: The starting dose of the drugs detailed below may be adjusted downward by the prescribing clinician, using their
L26@P0: independent medical judgement, to consider each patients individual clinical circumstances.
L27@P0: Ifosfamide is administered on days 1-5 of a 21 day cycle up to a maximum of 4 cycles unless the patient
L28@P0: experiences disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
L29@P0: Mesna is administered 1 hour prior to the first dose of ifosfamide on day 1 and is continued throughout the
L30@P0: chemotherapy, a final dose is given following the last ifosfamide dose as detailed in the treatment table
L31@P0: below.
L32@P0: Note:
L33@P0:  Hydration therapy required for safe administration of ifosfamide (See Table below)
L34@P0-1: Facilities to treat anaphylaxis MUST be present when systemic anti-cancer therapy (SACT) is administered. NCCP National SACT Regimen

L46@P1: This information is valid only on the day of printing, for any updates please check www.hse.ie/NCCPSACTregimens
L47@P1: Day Drug Dose Route Diluent & Rate Cycles
L48@P1: 1 Mesnaa 400mg/m2IV bolus Into the side arm of a fast-flowing NaCl 0.9%
L49@P1: drip 1 hour before the first dose of ifosfamide
L50@P1: Every 21 days for 4
L51@P1: cycles
L52@P1: 1-5 Ifosfamideb 3000mg/m2IV infusion 1000mL NaCl 0.9% over 24 hoursc Every 21 days for 4
L53@P1: cycles
L54@P1: 1-5 Mesnaa 3000mg/m2IV infusion 1000mL NaCl 0.9% over 24 hours
L55@P1: (continuous infusion commencing the same
L56@P1: time as the ifosfamide infusion)
L57@P1: Every 21 days for 4
L58@P1: cycles
L59@P1: 6 Mesnaa 800mg/m2IV bolusd
L60@P1: Into the side arm of a fast-flowing NaCl 0.9%
L61@P1: drip following the final dose of ifosfamide
L62@P1: Every 21 days for 4
L63@P1: cycles
L64@P1: aMesna is used to protect against haemorrhagic cystitis. Refer to Regimen Specific Complications.
L65@P1: b
L66@P1: Ifosfamide: Suggested Hydration therapy. (Refer to local policy or see suggested hydration below).
L67@P1: Ensure IV hydration (1000mL NaCL 0.9% IV every 6 hours) is given, commencing prior to first dose of ifosfamide and continuing for 24
L68@P1: hours after completion.
L69@P1: Furosemide should also be administered if required to ensure a urinary output of at least 100mL/hour
L70@P1:  Maintain strict fluid balance during therapy, by (1) monitoring fluid balance and (2) daily weights. If fluid balance becomes
L71@P1: positive by >1000mL or weight increases by >1 Kg, the patient should be reviewed and consideration given to diuresing with
L72@P1: furosemide.
L73@P1: c
L74@P1: In order to facilitate the infusion of ifosfamide over 24 hours consideration may be given to splitting the dose of ifosfamide over
L75@P1: multiple infusion bags for stability reasons.
L76@P1: dDose can also be given orally.
L77@P1: Note: Administration volumes and fluids have been standardised to facilitate electronic prescribing system builds.
L78@P1: ELIGBILITY:
L79@P1:  Histologically confirmed Ewing Sarcoma with disease progression (during or after completion of
L80@P1: first line treatment) or any subsequent recurrence
L81@P1: Or
L82@P1:  Refractory disease, defined by progression during first line treatment or within 12 weeks of its
L83@P1: completion
L84@P1:  Adequate hepatic, renal, and bone marrow function
L85@P1: EXCLUSIONS:
L86@P1:  Hypersensitivity to ifosfamide, mesna or any of the excipients
L87@P1:  Pregnancy
L88@P1:  Breastfeeding
L89@P1: PRESCRIPTIVE AUTHORITY:
